array.string: export PATH="/nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin:/run/current-system/sw/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:$HOME/.nix-profile/bin" set -e # 1. re-pin flake:nixpkgs to unstable HEAD (registry is user-level) nix registry pin nixpkgs github:NixOS/nixpkgs/nixpkgs-unstable # 2. refresh the home-manager flake lock and switch, so the # package set tracks the new pin cd "$HOME/.config/dotfiles/home-manager" nix flake update nix run home-manager/master -- switch --flake . # 3. GC old generations so unstable churn does not fill the disk nix run home-manager/master -- expire-generations "-7 days" || true nix-collect-garbage --delete-older-than 14d || true
